summary: Nexera Technologies Ltd filed a Form 6-K on June 9, 2026, reporting its majority-owned subsidiary Fort Technology Inc. received Nasdaq listing approval and commenced trading under ticker FRTT on June 8, 2026. Nexera holds approximately 70.94% of Fort’s common shares, and Fort will continue trading on TSXV under FORT. No financial terms, premium, or board advisors were disclosed. The mechanics involve a partial carve-out listing without a full spin-off distribution. The Nasdaq listing provides Fort independent access to capital markets. Watch for potential dilution from any future secondary offerings or eventual full spin-off.
